sermon.title: Holy Spirit Priorities
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: From 1 Corinthians 12:28 Pastor David G. Kincer shows God sets people in the church as he wills, ranked from apostles, prophets and teachers down to tongues. He explains the gifts of the Spirit, why the best gifts are those that edify, and why love is the more excellent way—showing what love looks like, why prophecy and tongues have not ceased, and how the fruit of the Spirit grows.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Points to check: Caiaphas prophesying Jesus’ “death, burial and resurrection” (John 11:51 speaks of his death); “Adam was a prophet”; about 15 apostles; 15 languages at Pentecost; one in three Pentecostals speaking in tongues; leading over 50 homosexuals to Christ (personal claim). faqs.question: Can Bible college make you a prophet or apostle?
faqs.answer: No—God sets people in the church as he sees fit.

faqs.question: Is being a helper less important?
faqs.answer: No—if God set you there it is your high calling, just as good as an apostle.

faqs.question: How many apostles were there?
faqs.answer: He says about fifteen in the New Testament, and they turned the world upside down.

faqs.question: Has the great falling away already happened?
faqs.answer: He says yes—now God is restoring all things.

faqs.question: Can you be filled with the Holy Ghost without speaking in tongues?
faqs.answer: Yes—it is a baptism of power.

faqs.question: Which gifts did Paul call best?
faqs.answer: The utterance gifts, because they edify and build the church.

faqs.question: Must a church help the community to be a church?
faqs.answer: He says no—God called the church to preach the gospel and build people in God.

faqs.question: Is anger always wrong?
faqs.answer: Righteous anger is fine—Jesus threw out the money changers—but not unrighteous anger.

faqs.question: Should Christians hate homosexuals?
faqs.answer: No—he wants them corrected and America protected, but they are human beings; he has led many to Christ.

faqs.question: How does the fruit of the Spirit grow?
faqs.answer: Naturally, by staying in the atmosphere of the word and his presence—not by naming and claiming it.
